# Scientific corrections and scope

29 October 2026. These qualifications are part of the results, not optional
administrative notes. Completed predecessor results retain their original
assumptions and evidence.

## Reversal, preparation and physical entropy

1. For arbitrary stationary hidden parity, the full stationary path KL is
   B+T sigma, with B=D(pi||piTheta). It is not T sigma unless B vanishes.
   The intrinsic rate contains escape-rate differences as well as jump
   logarithms. Stationary edge-flow entropy formulas from the all-even
   setting cannot be substituted silently.
2. B is distinguishability from the reversed preparation. In the new lift,
   a single orientation bit has unbounded B while its KL to an unbiased
   orientation stays below log 2. No unbounded work, stored-bit count or
   necessary external preparation time follows from B alone.
3. A fixed maximum microscopic escape clock does not bound hidden memory.
   The orientation construction keeps exactly 4n states and a common fixed
   clock while small switch rates, small stationary weights and the
   orientation relaxation time remain uncontrolled.
4. All results labeled entropy are path-reversal divergence results under
   the stated reversal contract. A heat or physical thermodynamic claim
   needs the actual reversal, relevant odd external fields, reservoirs and
   local detailed balance. No universal thermal realization of the abstract
   completions has been constructed.
5. The older generalized-equilibrium ambiguity keeps its parity-invariant
   equilibrium requirement. The new small-rate completion uses asymmetric
   stationary preparation and slow relaxation; it does not turn arbitrary
   irreversible data into an exact irreducible equilibrium law.

# Stored orientation information can hide sustained dissipation

29 October 2026. Root construction following the entropy-completion and
metric-tree results. This is an identifiability theorem under a declared
physical-reversal class, not a low-heat implementation of an arbitrary
process. Physical heat claims require additional thermodynamic structure.

## 1. The new obstruction

For the all-even class, small stationary entropy forces finite path laws
close to equilibrium, yielding the complete tree-witness theory. For
arbitrary hidden parity, a stationary preparation can itself distinguish
forward from reversed paths. The sustained rate alone need not control
finite-window irreversibility.

**Theorem.** Let Q be any finite irreducible CTMC with n states, stationary
law pi, and deterministic finite-alphabet readout g. For every finite
horizon T, accuracy delta>0 and sustained-rate target eta>0, there exists
an irreducible 4n-state CTMC and a physical-reversal involution Theta such
that:

1. The readout is even: g(Theta z)=g(z).
2. Its stationary observed path law on [0,T] is within delta in total
   variation of the stationary observed path law of Q.
3. Its intrinsic stationary Theta-reversal divergence rate is below eta.
4. Every microscopic state has the SAME escape rate Lambda, where Lambda
   depends on Q but not on delta or eta.

The cost is not hidden dimension or an increasing maximum clock. The
stationary preparation's parity divergence can grow, and orientation
relaxation can become arbitrarily slow. Resolved singleton reset states
fixed by reversal, a known preparation-divergence bound, or an all-even
microscopic model are additional information that excludes the construction.

Consequently every finite-source coarse path law has robust sustained-
entropy floor zero in this unrestricted-parity/preparation class, even
when its observed law has a clear time arrow. This statement concerns
finite-window approximation. It does not assert a zero-rate irreducible
model that reproduces the full target path law exactly.

# The entropy floor of a regenerative event record

29 October 2026, Brisbane. Root construction. This is a variational
characterization in an explicit record topology, not an exact-record
optimizer or a physical thermal device.

## 1. Record and physical scope

B is a finite set of resolved singleton microscopic ports, all fixed
by physical reversal. K_ij(t) is the stationary FLUX density of a hidden
excursion from port i to its next port j, with positive interior duration
t. Native initial port holds are separate. Direct flux d_ij, i!=j, is
also separate; d_ii=0. Let F_ij=integral K_ij and rho_i=sum_j(F_ij+d_ij).
Assume port row and column flux sums agree and the trace is irreducible.
Assume R>0 whenever using per-departure or mean-cycle quantities; the
event-free singleton case has E=J=V=0 and is treated separately.
Supplied positive port weights w_i fix native holding rates rho_i/w_i.
Let V=sum_ij integral t K_ij(t)dt be finite, W=sum_i w_i+V, R=sum_i rho_i.

The observed event-flux reversal divergence is

    J(K,d)=sum_ij integral K_ij(t)log[K_ij(t)/K_ji(t)]dt
                      +sum_i!=j d_ij log(d_ij/d_ji).       (1)

Assume J is finite. Supports are therefore reciprocal up to null sets.
For a finite hidden CTMC with stationary weights w and involution Theta
fixing B, define its intrinsic stationary reversal-divergence rate by

    E=sum_x w_x [sum_y!=x q_xy log(q_xy/q_Theta(y),Theta(x))
                            +lambda_Theta(x)-lambda_x], (2)

where lambda_x=-q_xx. Then sigma=E/W is the long-horizon path KL rate.
The fixed-horizon stationary path KL also has boundary D(pi||pi Theta).
Here pi need not be Theta-invariant. Thermodynamic interpretation requires
faithful physical reversal and local detailed balance. The prior all-even
and midpoint-operation theorems keep their own assumptions unchanged.

Microscopic excursion-flux KL equals E: port-weight endpoint terms cancel
by balanced port traffic, jump terms average to stationary edge fluxes,
and holding terms average to occupation. Because ports are fixed renewal
states, no hidden initial-preparation boundary survives this regenerative
identity. Data processing gives E>=J. This lower bound is established
Markovian-event machinery; the new target is a matching converse.
